credit_lending_product.value: Purchased nonperforming loan portfolios: defaulted credit cards, consumer loans, insolvency accounts and auto loans; plus fee-based recovery services

origination_channel.value: Portfolios purchased from banks and credit issuers in the Americas, Europe and Australia; not originated directly

delinquency_by_aging_bucket.value: Buys already nonperforming loans, so delinquency buckets are not a reported measure of its book

notes: Website lacks funding, yield and loss details; the company is a debt buyer rather than a lender.
